scoreRationale: A handsome planned village with the Dalhousie Arch, an unusual Victorian hall, two café-led stops, practical Muir facilities and direct walking and cycling choices. Edzell Castle is separately scored.

heritage.dateRule: Construction or material-period dates only; never designation, listing or database dates.

namedTrailSearch.TreasureTrails: No exact Edzell product found on the live provider site.

practicalAudit.see: Three independently scored visitor places; castle explicitly separate from settlement score.
practicalAudit.eat: Two cafe-led daytime venues; full-meal restaurants and distant glen venues excluded.
practicalAudit.picnic: One managed council picnic and barbecue area at Edzell Muir.
practicalAudit.parking: One exact public car park; capacity, tariff, payment, maximum stay and accessible-space count explicitly unconfirmed.
practicalAudit.toilets: One council toilet with RADAR accessible provision; hours, fee and baby changing explicitly unconfirmed.
practicalAudit.accessibility: Hall and castle accessibility detail recorded; routes and Muir surfaces require on-arrival judgement.
practicalAudit.transport: Village is walkable from the Muir; castle is about 1.6 km west and treated separately.

exclusions: Edzell Castle does not inflate the settlement score.
The storm-damaged Shakin Brig is not promoted as an accessible attraction.
Rocks of Solitude is not duplicated over the official Blue Door route while bridge access is disrupted.
No exact commercial clue-trail product is invented.
